Strips all Markdown links and bare URLs from any text, leaving only the plain content.
1. Detect link patterns:
  Markdown links: display text
  Bare URLs:  or 
  Optionally: www. prefixed domains
2. Remove them:
    Delete the entire Markdown construct including brackets and parentheses
    Strip bare URLs wherever they appear inline or on their own line
3. Preserve everything else:
Edge cases handled:

 Links inside brackets like [text] — strips inner link only
 Multiple links on one line — removes all
 Link text that spans lines — not matched by default (singleline safe)
 Empty brackets after removal — cleaned up

To extend: Add domainlevel deduplication if you want to keep source names but drop the actual URLs, or add anchor text extraction to preserve the display name from every link.

Also clean the entire text from this characters at all: “de ne ilyen gagyin fogalmazz mar xd Define what you want & what success looks like: “” “” ““ “”  (only keep if the character is part of a code)

A megadott instrukciók optimalizált, felesleges sallangoktól mentes promptja:



Task: Strip all Markdown links ([text](url)), bare URLs (http://, https://, www.), and raw Markdown formatting characters (#,  ` , -, *) from the input text, completely removing link syntax, empty leftover brackets, and standalone symbols while keeping these characters intact inside code blocks.  
Requirements: Process singleline and nested link patterns cleanly without altering the remaining body text, and output only the sanitized plain text.  
Success Criteria: The result contains zero web links or stray Markdown formatting symbols, preserving only the clean alphanumeric content and properly formatted code segments.



 Főbb optimalizálási szempontok
 Tömörség: A feladat, a követelmények és a siker kritériumai pontosan 3 célratörő mondatban lettek összegezve.
 Karaktertörlés pontosítása: A formázó karakterek (#,  ` , -, *) szűrése külön szabályként érvényesül, megtartva a kódblokkok integritását.
 Szerepkörök elhagyása: A felesleges körítés és szerepjáték helyett közvetlen bemenetfeldolgozáskimenet logikára épül.
